tasks.short: Direct installation or testing of remote sensing hardware or software.

steps.what: Confirm the actual installation or test objectives, site constraints, sensor or software revision and acceptance criteria
Prepare the installation or test direction sheet with the actual sequence, responsibilities, interfaces and acceptance checks
outputs: checked installation or test direction sheet

steps.what: Direct installation or testing of new remote sensing hardware or software with the actual technical staff and resolve emerging problems
inputs: checked installation or test direction sheet
actual technical work and observed problems
outputs: actual coordination decisions and completed test references

steps.what: Compare actual test readings and installation evidence with the specified criteria and investigate failures and incomplete tests
inputs: actual coordination decisions and completed test references
test operators' actual readings and logs from remote sensing test software {OTHER}
outputs: verified results, unresolved failures and acceptance limitations

steps.what: Write and check the actual installation or test direction outcome, result references, limitations and further work
inputs: verified results, unresolved failures and acceptance limitations
outputs: checked final technical direction outcome and internal project destination

steps.what: Save the checked actual installation or test direction outcome in the internal project record
inputs: checked final technical direction outcome and internal project destination

tasks.design: Configure reusable direction-sheet sections in {DOCS}, then test native result comparison in the remote sensing test software {OTHER} before adding a {SPREADSHEET} view. Match actual run IDs and readings to agreed criteria, flag missing or failed checks and keep on-site direction, exception judgement and the actual outcome record human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Procedural headings and test-result comparisons may be repeated across revisions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates and threshold views can reuse known structure and actual test logs.
tasks.still_hard: Diagnosing site-specific failures and deciding whether evidence is sufficient.
tasks.human_edge: Coordinating technical specialists when hardware, interfaces and field conditions disagree.

ambition.what: Review failed acceptance checks before the technical team leaves the test setup.

tasks.altitude: Less procedural layout and comparison arithmetic; scientific and installation authority remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Record actual run, revision, units and missing-test status.

evidence.claim: Native test result views can compare actual numeric readings to explicit thresholds while preserving human investigation of failures.

assumptions: Boundary is the scientist's direction, result review and actual outcome record. Technicians' physical installation, software deployment and test execution are outside this focal denominator; their effort and existing system runtime receive no saving. This design executes no hardware setting or software deployment.

The scientist supplies acceptance criteria, units, tolerances, required conditions and procedure revision. Actual test operators produce device ID, software revision, run ID, timestamp, condition, reading, unit and log link. Missing or paper logs require manual capture and checking; a scheduled test is not a completed test.

Try native templates and test comparison tools first. The direction-sheet reduction is reused headings and approved procedural sections, not automated selection of safe procedures. Result comparisons only match explicit compatible units and thresholds; missing or incomparable readings remain exceptions.
No model decides installation safety, scientific validity or acceptance. Any actual deployment remains under the site's existing change procedure outside this direction-only design.

The normal final author check in s5 binds a1 to the complete outcome, evidence links, limitations and exact internal project record. Edits require rechecking. The ordinary save remains 1% fully retained.
unknowns: Availability of actual structured test logs and native comparison functions.
Current time spent on comparison mechanics versus diagnosis.
research_questions: Can native comparison preserve failed, missing and incomparable tests without treating a threshold match as full acceptance?

already_counted.description: Prepare the direction sheet, review actual comparisons and write and check the actual outcome.

incremental.description: Maintain result-field mappings, explicit criteria and reusable procedure revisions.

approvals.approved_version: Complete final actual installation or test direction outcome, result references, limitations and exact internal project destination checked in s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Direction-sheet mechanics save 5 points and actual result comparisons 8; gross 13 less 1.5 upkeep. Low is no deployment when native tools already cover this work or logs remain manual. Technical execution, direction and diagnosis receive no benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The scientist keeps technical direction and scientific judgement while reducing repeated procedural layout and result comparison.
reach: Help technicians maintain traceable run and configuration references.
skills_to_grow: Separate test evidence from planned work
role.ambitious_version: Resolve a failed acceptance check while the actual test setup and specialists are still available.
